# Uptown Clover

Uptown Clover is the dapper Manehattan businessman in *Friendship Is Magic* who initially insists he is too busy to help his neighborhood, then discovers that even small contributions matter. He runs an oat and hay import/export business.

[![Uptown Clover with Viola — Hasbro Studios / Friendship Is Magic, S5E16](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/14/758342/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/posts/758342)

- Appearance: Tall, slender earth pony stallion with a golden-yellow coat, lavender-purple mane and tail, violet eyes, curled mustache, sideburns, blue top hat, matching suit and dark cravat.
- Name: Uptown Clover is the fandom/catalog name. His credited role is Business Pony; no on-screen use of the personal name or original naming vote was verified. [Cast listing](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt4534332/fullcredits/).
- Speaking status: Speaking character, voiced in English by Colin Murdock (credited as Colin Murdoch).
- Appearances: Debuts in Made in Manehattan (S5E16); the [stallion catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Stallions) also lists The Gift of the Maud Pie (S6E3), A Royal Problem (S7E10), and Fake It 'Til You Make It (S8E4) as appearances. No separate speaking role in those later episodes was verified.

## Important moments

Both scenes are from [Made in Manehattan (S5E16)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/made-in-manehattan/umc.cmc.5ibiby5876oaxd68lonxw6nz0), first aired September 26, 2015. Exact video timestamps could not be verified; the [episode transcript](https://www.springfieldspringfield.co.uk/view_episode_scripts.php?episode=s05e16&tv-show=my-little-pony-friendship-is-magic) confirms the dialogue.

- **Too busy for the revival** (S5E16; timestamp unavailable): Despite fond memories of Charity Kindheart's theater revival, he rejects Applejack's invitation to volunteer, citing the demands of his business.
- **Small acts, big difference** (S5E16; timestamp unavailable): After watching the revived neighborhood play, he recognizes that modest efforts can unite the community and predicts that others will join in, helping confirm that the friendship mission succeeded.

Research limits: The image is a verified show capture, not fan art. No securely attributed fan artwork or original naming history was located. The cast and character-catalog listings were accessible through indexed search excerpts, but direct page retrieval was blocked.
